h: UNILAG reportedly offers admission to candidate who scored 323 in JAMB twice after she turned down LASU
p: A young woman who reportedly scored 323 in JAMB on two occasions has said to have been offered admission by the University of Lagos. She had reportedly rejected a place at Lagos State University earlier. The story is drawing comment from Nigerians online.
more: The candidate is said to have turned down LASU while waiting for a UNILAG place.
Social media users are sharing their own JAMB admission experiences.
